description: Vector measurements, source frames 0-155. Caps: full-resolution dark connected-component hulls. Silhouettes: half-resolution green/yellow contours simplified to 2.5px. Crossings partitioned by cap-guided quadratic centerlines fitted to isolated scanlines. Hidden cap seeds interpolate adjacent complete measurements; only measured visible cap polygons are drawn. Gradient colors are row medians, unpremultiplied against #f7f7f7. Low-saturation tails extrapolate 40px/16px to transparent ends. Crossing depth, tail extrapolation, blur and procedural grain approximate the source.
